### The Angel Brings Judgment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/angel-brings-judgment
Passage: 1 Chronicles 21:15
Points:
- David's census brought severe divine discipline upon Israel, showing that God holds sinners accountable for their pride and disobedience.
- In His holy sovereignty, God can direct secondary causes to fulfill His purposes while remaining free from all evil.
- The angel executing judgment over Jerusalem foreshadows Christ, who will bring righteous judgment against impenitent sinners.
- The Lord demonstrated great mercy by staying the destroying angel's hand as David confessed his wrongdoing and sought forgiveness.
- Those who turn to Jesus in obedient faith are spared the wrath of God through His abundant grace.
